pages: Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, stands at the foot of the climb with one hand flat on the low dry stone wall, looking up the path. Middle distance: two leaning fence posts, the old gun emplacements. Background: the Bridle Path going up the Port Hills. Dry morning light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, sits at the hallway table and presses two fingers to the inside of her left wrist, counting. Middle distance: one open health book propped on its spine, a school satchel on the floor. Background: the hallway's long window. Flat morning light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, buttoned to the throat, stands alone in the schoolyard with one palm flat on the low brick wall, chin down, thinking. Middle distance: a bicycle shed, a litter bin. Background: school windows under a grey sky. Flat overcast light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, sits on the wall the whole way up the path with both hands pushed inside her sleeves, listening to herself breathe. Middle distance: a bare hedge, a marker post. Background: the path climbing away, grey hills. Overcast light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, stands very still on the hill path, chin lifted, one steel chestpiece held flat against her ribs and its rubber tube hanging. Middle distance: one school bag on the grass, a steel wristwatch. Background: the ridge and the old gun emplacements. Flat morning light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, presses two fingers hard into the inside of her left wrist and counts, eyes shut. Middle distance: one flat steel wristwatch with a leather strap, the chestpiece set down on the wall. Background: rooftops below the path. Grey morning light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, tilts her head to listen, one hand flat on her own chest. Middle distance: one steel chestpiece and its rubber tube lying on the wall, a satchel on the grass. Background: the schoolyard wall, bare branches above. Overcast light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, holds up one small closed fist in front of her chest and looks at it. Middle distance: the steel chestpiece and its tube on the wall, one stopwatch. Background: the open hillside and the gun emplacements. Bright morning light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, flapping at the hem, stands at the crest with one hand flat on the wall and two fingers on her wrist. Middle distance: two marker posts, the path falling away. Background: the harbour and the city far below. Clear hill light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, runs on up the track with her mouth open and two fingers on her wrist. Middle distance: one folded timing card in her other hand, a low stone wall beside it. Background: the slope and the sky. Hard bright light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, sits on the wall with her back against a fence post, writing on the back of one folded timing card with a pencil. Middle distance: her school bag, the path. Background: the hillside in flat afternoon light.

Wren, a girl of nine, black hair in two plaits, mustard-yellow raincoat with its hood down, presses two fingers hard on her wrist and counts again, one soft pencil held loosely in her other hand above the card. Middle distance: the fence post, her satchel. Background: the valley in low evening light.
